achievements.name: Firecracker
achievements.detail: Find the firecrackers near the start and set one off to scare a creature or light the dark.

achievements.name: First Flame
achievements.detail: Light a flame in one region of the well and bring it back to the central chamber.

achievements.name: Disc
achievements.detail: Take the disc and throw it so you can ride it across a gap or hit a distant switch.

achievements.name: Bubble Wand
achievements.detail: Find the bubble wand and stand on a bubble to reach a ledge above you.

achievements.name: Slink
achievements.detail: Collect the slink and send it down a staircase onto a floor switch.

achievements.name: Yo-yo
achievements.detail: Pick up the yo-yo and use it to strike a switch or turn a creature around on its wheel.

achievements.name: First Egg
achievements.detail: Find one egg hidden in a chest away from the route between the flames.

achievements.name: Animal Flute
achievements.detail: Collect eight eggs and claim the animal flute waiting in the egg room.

achievements.name: Four Flames
achievements.detail: Return every flame to the chamber at the center of the well.

achievements.name: Lantern
achievements.detail: Enter the final region after the flames are restored and pick up the lantern.

achievements.name: The Surface
achievements.detail: Finish the last climb and complete the journey out of the well.

achievements.name: Every Egg
achievements.detail: Gather all sixty-four eggs hidden throughout the well.
